headline: The man accused of pistol-whipping Rick Ross’ son has been released from jail on a $50,000
body: The man accused of pistol-whipping Rick Ross’ son has been released from jail on a $50,000 bond after spending six days behind bars. His release comes a day after 50 Cent offered to pay his bail to spite Rick Ross.
